_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue fell 9.8% to $46,014 while ad spend rose 28.9% to $6,774, so TACoS climbed from 10.3% to 14.7%.
The three biggest kits all slipped: Essential Kit -13%, Signature Kit -15%, Refresh Kit -28%. The All-Natural cleaning solutions grew 15%.
refunds: Refunds were $628 this week (1.56% refund rate), down from $905 the week before. Nothing here needs action.
pacing_reco: November has one day in ($7,663). Keeping Essential Kit in stock through Black Friday matters most: it has about 2.6 weeks of stock available at FBA.
ads_context: Ad sales fell 9% to $18,001 while spend rose 29%, so ACoS went from 26.6% to 37.6%.
Sponsored Products spend rose 47% to $2,818 and Sponsored Brands rose 23% to $2,513.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $7,497 on $1,242 (16.6% ACoS) and brought 224 orders.
Category keywords cost $4,853 for $8,320 in sales (58.3% ACoS); that spend was up 46% on last week.
bid_moves: Lower bids on the Sponsored Brands “shoe cleaning” phrase target: $1,004 spent at 70% ACoS.
Lower bids on “shoe cleaner sneakers” and “sneaker cleaning kit” (exact): both above 65% ACoS.
Pause or negate the 78 campaigns with spend and no sales ($342 this week).
promotions: This week: 339 promotion orders and $927 in promotional discounts (vs 447 orders and $1,514 last week).
Less discounting lines up with the drop in kit sales.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: Essential Kit replenishment landed at FBA before Nov 20.
